content.text: The visible suite now passes (2 passed). I changed only `solution/core.py`. The cause was in `merge`: when an interval overlapped the last merged one, the code set the merged end to the new interval's end, unconditionally. So a contained interval like `(2, 3)` inside `(1, 4)` shrank the result to `(1, 3)`. The fix sets the end to `max(previous_end, b)`. While there, I removed a dead `if a == pb and not join_touching` branch, which had no effect beyond the appending the code already did. Touching-interval handling, exact-duplicate collapsing, and the reversed-interval `ValueError` behave as before. I also spot-checked containment, touching with and without `join_touching`, duplicates, a multi-interval chain, and empty input, and they all gave the expected results. Nothing under `tests/` was touched, and `merge`'s signature is unchanged.
